records.claim_text: Acas separates whether an employment-term change is needed from consultation and agreement routes, including relevant representative arrangements. This is a different decision object from a software purchase.
records.locator: Consulting: Who you should consult/How you should consult; considering: How changes can be agreed/What to consider first
records.population: One Acas employer contract-change guide; consulting and considering sections, not an employer survey
records.limitations: Scope limited to proposed employment-term changes. No universal employee veto over software, duty applied to every configuration change, legal remedy or employer-specific conclusion inferred.
records.review_mode: Relevant original HTML sections inspected; original capture retained; no employer-specific legal analysis
records.time_period: Live guidance inspected 29 October 2026; no event-frequency measure

records.claim_text: ICO monitoring guidance treats worker input, DPO advice and conditional prior regulatory consultation as distinct considerations; their applicability must be established for the actual processing context.
records.locator: Lawful basis/Consent; DPIA; Should we discuss monitoring; live review warning
records.population: Monitoring/data practices, not an observed payroll-buying population
records.limitations: Live guidance explicitly under review following Data (Use and Access) Act. Conditional monitoring context, not employer-specific legal advice, a universal payroll veto, or proof consultation is valid processing consent.
records.review_mode: Relevant original HTML sections inspected; original capture retained; no employer-specific legal analysis
records.time_period: Live guidance inspected 29 October 2026; no event-frequency measure
